Indie rock darlings Duchy, five members of Dawes, recently settled in Northern California—and they're ready to put in all those hours in their new 1,600-square-foot post office.

Goldsworth is good at writing pop songs, as he showed during his time with the very pop Grand Duchy, but the best things here are his raw vocals on songs that are either soaring and angelic or wild and heartfelt.
